Antibiotic.name: Antibiotic
Antibiotic.description:
If a target has started the natural healing process injecting them with pharmaceutical will cause them to heal an additional 2 Hit Points per day for a week.

Pharmaceuticals must be administered by a trained Medtech

Effect does not stack

Black Lace.name: Black Lace
Black Lace.description:
Primary Effect Dose lasts 24 hours

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save

  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned

  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2

Blue Glass.name: Blue Glass
Blue Glass.description:
Primary Effect Dose lasts 4 hours

  • The GM may occasionally tell the user that they are seeing swirls of colours. When this happens the user loses their action on a single turn

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • The GM may occasionally tell the user that they are seeing swirls of colours. When this happens the user loses their action on a single turn

Boost.name: Boost
Boost.description:
Primary Effect Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user has INT +2 for the duration

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • INT -2

Rapidetox.name: Rapidetox
Rapidetox.description:
Injecting a target with this pharmaceutical will eliminate the effects of any drugs, poisons, or intoxicants that are affecting the subject.

Pharmaceuticals must be administered by a trained Medtech

Smash.name: Smash
Smash.description:
Primary Effect Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • The user feels happy and satisfied, receiving a temporary modifier of +2 to Acting, Contortionist, Conversation, Dance, Human Perception, and Persuasion

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • While addicted, user suffers a -2 modifier to Acting, Contortionist, Conversation, Dance, Human Perception, and Persuasion

GM will tell your when you crave more Smash. Roleplay accordingly.

Speedheal.name: Speedheal
Speedheal.description:
Injecting a target with this pharmaceutical immediately causes them to heal HP equal to [[/r @stats.body+@stats.will#Speedheal]]{BODY plus their WILL}.

Pharmaceuticals must be administered by a trained Medtech

This effect does not work on Mortally Wounded targets, and can only be used on a target once per day.

Stim.name: Stim
Stim.description:
Injecting a target with this pharmaceutical causes them to ignore all penalties from being Seriously Wounded for one hour.

Pharmaceuticals must be administered by a trained Medtech

It can only be used on a target once per day.

Add this item to the target's inventory to apply the supplied AE

Surge.name: Surge
Surge.description:
Injecting a target with this pharmaceutical causes them to be immune to sleep deprivation (see pg 377). Effect lasts for 24 hours.

Pharmaceuticals must be administered by a trained Medtech

Can only be used on a target once per week.

Synthcoke.name: Synthcoke
Synthcoke.description:
Primary Effect Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • The user feels paranoid occasionally

  • +1 REF for the duration

Secondary Effect [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs}

  • -2 REF unless under the Primary Effect

GM will tell your when you crave more Smash. Roleplay accordingly.
